verdict.rationale: Resend ships a first-party MCP server (resend/resend-mcp) that connects to Cursor, Claude and other MCP clients. Through it, users can run actions such as adding and verifying domains and configuring webhooks with natural-language prompts. The natural-language layer itself comes from the external AI client, not from Resend, and the scheduling field that accepts phrases like 'in 1 min' is only a minor related feature. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product, full documentation of which operations the MCP server covers, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
